answer: The butcher's block stands scrubbed white, and the hooks hang empty overhead. Proof of butcher via cleaver cut tally — a side the butcher cuts only after 22 sides fall clean at the joint, each side cut by the butcher himself. hollow breaks the side down joint by joint, the cleaver falling clean. haven trims the fat and hangs the cuts to chill. lagoon weighs each joint and chalks the price on the slate. A forger needs 22 sides cut without a ragged edge, and the twenty-third still splinters at the bone.
